open_items: Contains nuts and egg-white: amaretto is the story (his drink), so the room kept it; the plan flagged this from the start.

Morgenthaler's own two printings disagree (Oxford vs the 2012 post), and amaretto's sugar and ABV are on no page the room had; Tomás swept the sugar (holds roughly 20–33 g/100 ml). His printed fix reads too sweet on paper, so the glass is the room's riff: his cask-strength bourbon kept, sherry vinegar as the spark (Flavor Matrix pdf 184).
"The best" stays his claim, quoted. The reading claims no resentment beyond what his own page shows.
